title: Agent Control Production Hardening
status: Production verified on GitHub/Vercel; existing Supabase quota and farm intelligence services preserved
summary: Completed the Agent Control hardening release with live plan capacity visibility, quota-aware workspace guards, safe user-facing errors and bounded observability, complete loading/empty/error treatment, and Chapter 123-style assessment opportunity farming with ranked annual tax-impact results and direct Opportunity Desk handoff.

items.detail: Frontend now reads the live get_agent_usage() contract and leaves the existing Supabase database/function enforcement as the final authority.
Agent Control displays property, live-farm and territory usage with plan limits, remaining capacity, 80% warning state and hard-limit state.
New farms, territories and sphere imports are checked against live remaining capacity before submission, including partial CSV capacity messaging.
Known auth, plan, quota and network failures receive safe copy; unknown failures receive AGT reference IDs while internal detail is sent through platform observability.
Territories, live lists and conversion funnel retain explicit loading and explanatory empty states; failed panels gain safe retry behavior.
Farm Map now exposes Chapter 123 screening, annual tax-impact, percent-above-upper-limit and assessment-reduction thresholds plus $750/$1,500/$2,500 presets.
Assessment-screened farms default-sort by estimated annual tax impact and expose assessment, recorded sale, ratio/upper limit, supported assessment, reduction and annual impact.
Qualifying parcels can be added once to Opportunity Desk with a persisted factual assessment-review reason, source/date context and no seller-intent language.
Latest main deployment is READY in Vercel production; production Agent Control and Farm Map return HTTP 200 with the new assets, and no matching Vercel runtime errors were found during verification.
